profile.headline: Senior Frontend Engineer / Senior Angular Developer
profile.summary:
Highly creative and results-driven Senior Front-End/Full-Stack Web Application Developer with over 15 years of experience building and enhancing user-focused applications. Proven expertise in Angular, GraphQL, and React, with a strong foundation in modern web technologies and a passion for performance and emerging tech. Expert in accessibility (WCAG 2.2/GAR), specializing in migrating and modernizing legacy codebases while mentoring junior developers. Proactively leverages Generative AI tools as pair programmers to optimize code quality, solve complex architectural issues, and accelerate development workflows. Demonstrated ability to engineer creative technical workarounds, such as custom SSL tunneling for screen reader testing, to maintain high standards of quality assurance.

Technical Skills 

Frontend: Angular (2–19), Angular Material, Angular Store, Angular PWA, Storybook, React, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, LESS, Bootstrap, jQuery, JSON, Webpack, RxJS, NgRx, Jest, Cypress, Jasmine, Cucumber, Accessibility (WCAG 2.2/GAR), NVDA Screen Reader.
Backend: Node.js, Express.js, GraphQL, Python, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, ActiveRecord
Other: Git, Docker, LLM Application Development (Ollama), GitHub Copilot, AI Development Tools (Cursor, Gemini), Drone Development, 3D Printing (Fusion 360/TPU), Adobe Creative Suite, Shell Scripting, SSL Tunneling, Apache Configuration, Server OS Installation, XML, Perl, PHP.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
A highly motivated Senior Frontend Engineer specializing in Angular development and building impactful, user-centric web applications. Experienced collaborating with cross-functional teams in Agile environments to deliver scalable and reliable applications. Skilled in leveraging innovative tools, including AI-powered solutions, to streamline processes and enhance code quality.

* Contributed to the development & implementation of a migration process for Angular components, improving consistency and maintainability across a large-scale application serving over 200 internal teams.
* Implemented standardized migration processes, resulting in significantly improved UI performance and reduced boilerplate code.
* Developed and maintained complex UI components in Angular, TypeScript, and JavaScript, prioritizing stability, usability, and production-quality coding standards.
* Championed web accessibility best practices, remediating over 50+ complex issues based on WCAG and GAR guidelines, and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Implemented comprehensive ARIA attributes and accessible UI patterns to ensure seamless experiences for users with disabilities.
* Collaborated closely with backend developers, testers, and stakeholders to deliver impactful features and resolve complex technical challenges within an Agile environment.
* Proactively addressed technical debt through component updates, code refactoring, and modernization efforts, improving code health and maintainability.
* Contributed to the architecture and implementation of scalable web applications within the Akali/OneStack ecosystem.
* Leveraged AI-powered tools for legacy code analysis, identifying hidden dependencies, and streamlining development processes.
* Authored and maintained robust unit, E2E, and visual regression tests using the Angular Testing Framework, ensuring application stability and reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · Angular Material · JavaScript · SASS · AngularDart · Angular Templates · TypeScript

positions.title: Engineer, Software Process Engineering
positions.description:
Developed and modernized front-end applications for Samsung Smart TVs, evolving the architecture from AngularJS to React, and integrating full-stack capabilities with Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL to manage campaigns and user data.

* Developed interactive HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript modules for the SmartHub platform.
* Built and maintained Campaign Manager, Accounts Manager, and Analytics applications.
* Implemented Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) E2E tests using industry-standard tools.
* Modernized the TV Simulator by migrating from AngularJS to Angular 8, incorporating PWA.
* Spearheaded the transition to React, utilizing functional components, hooks, and GraphQL.
* Mentored junior developers, guiding them on best practices and new technologies.

Full-Stack (March 2021 onwards):
* Generated and executed database migration scripts for PostgreSQL using ActiveRecord.
* Created and maintained robust and efficient ActiveRecord models and services.
* Wrote thorough unit tests using ActiveSupport TestCase and MiniTest for code quality.
* Leveraged Kubernetes for efficient deployment, scaling, and management of applications.

positions.title: Front End Engineer (Intelliswift)
positions.description:
Significantly improved the usability and performance of StubHub.com's high-traffic Events section by leveraging Web 2.0 technologies (jQuery, Backbone, RequireJS), optimizing CSS with LESS, and implementing a robust unit testing framework using Karma and Jasmine.
 
* Enhanced user experience in the high-traffic Events section using jQuery and Backbone.js.
* Implemented RequireJS for optimized dependency management and modular development.
* Significantly improved styling and responsiveness with LESS, enhancing visual appeal.
* Introduced and implemented AngularJS and SASS for improved development workflows.
* Helped lead the development and implementation of a unit testing framework with Karma and Jasmine.
* Contributed to A/B testing initiatives to optimize user engagement and conversions.

positions.title: Senior UI Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on the redesign and modernization of Gap's POS and PDA systems, implementing a mobile-first strategy using AngularJS, HTML5, and responsive design with SASS (Bourbon Neat), resulting in a more efficient and user-friendly experience for store associates and customers.

* Developed dynamic and responsive web applications for Point of Sale (POS) devices.
* Utilized AngularJS, HTML5, and RequireJS for modern and efficient web development.
* Implemented a SASS-based framework (Bourbon Neat) for streamlined and reusable styling.
* Ensured cross-device compatibility and responsiveness using modern design principles.
* Provided mentorship and training to junior UI developers, fostering team growth.
* Collaborated effectively with teams to ensure consistent UI/UX across platforms.

positions.title: Web Developer - Front-end
positions.description:
Developed and maintained various web applications for Apple, including mobile-first solutions for training and internal tools, using jQuery, jQuery UI, jQuery Mobile, and HTML5.  Researched and introduced new JavaScript frameworks like AngularJS and Handlebars to improve development workflows.
 
* Developed mobile-first training applications using HTML5, jQuery, and jQuery Mobile.
* Maintained and updated the UI code for the Apple Concierge Web App, enhancing usability.
* Researched and introduced JavaScript frameworks like AngularJS and Handlebars.js.
* Resolved bugs related to HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Java Server Pages, improving stability.
* Worked extensively in a Linux/Apache/Tomcat environment, managing code with SVN.
* Translated web designer mockups and comps into functional and interactive applications.

positions.title: Web Applications Developer
positions.description:
As the sole front-end developer in my last couple years for VMware.com, I maintained and enhanced the website, ensuring cross-browser compatibility, integrating third-party templates, implementing Web 2.0 features, and introducing mobile enhancements using jQuery Mobile and Modernizr.  Collaborated closely with marketing and web producers to deliver a consistent and user-friendly online experience.

* Maintained and updated VMware.com, ensuring seamless cross-browser compatibility.
* Successfully integrated third-party HTML templates into the Interwoven CMS platform.
* Implemented engaging Web 2.0 features such as the Geo-Location Selector and carousels.
* Introduced mobile enhancements using jQuery Mobile and Modernizr for broader reach.
* Incorporated social media widgets and analytical tracking tools for enhanced insights.
* Addressed website issues related to HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, ensuring optimal performance.
* Collaborated with marketing to effectively plan and implement mobile functionalities.

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
Managed and supported DocuShare OnDemand websites in the US and New Zealand, ensuring service availability, troubleshooting user issues, collaborating with QA to set up test environments, and acting as a liaison between sales and engineering to improve scalability and reduce customer support call volume.

* Managed and ensured 24/7 availability of DocuShare OnDemand websites globally.
* Provided timely technical support and efficiently resolved user-reported issues.
* Set up and maintained robust test environments utilizing Apache, Tomcat, and MySQL.
* Collaborated with sales and engineering teams to enhance product scalability.
* Provided essential web development and programming services across departments.
* Significantly reduced customer support call volume through proactive troubleshooting.
